high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban scene at sunset. The sky is a beautiful blend of soft pastel hues, transitioning from warm oranges and yellows near the horizon to cooler blues and purples higher up. Wispy clouds are scattered across the sky, adding texture and depth to the scene. In the foreground, there is a railway track with a train partially visible. The train appears to be stationary or moving very slowly, as it is not in motion blur. The train carriages have a modern design with a metallic finish, featuring red and blue stripes along their sides.
